subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs) — Acme Maps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Harris <sam.harris@acme-maps.com>, Priya Varma <priya.varma@acme-maps.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs) — Acme Maps

Hi Sam / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned on the MAP milestone for Integration Build Plan.

Summary of the ask:
- Acme wants an SDK integration to our hosted API + streaming responses for live map annotations.
- Support for tool-calling (external geocoding service) and structured JSON outputs for your analytics pipeline.

Proposed MAP milestone (draft):
1) Integration design sign-off (owner: Acme engineering / Priya) — Target: 2027-02-18
2) SDK integration (owner: Redwood devrel / Rafael) — Target: 2027-03-04
3) Streaming + KV cache tests (owner: Redwood infra / Vivek) — Target: 2027-03-11
4) Tool-calling connector (owner: Acme eng / Sam + Redwood SE) — Target: 2027-03-18
5) Structured outputs schema + validation (owner: Acme data / Priya; Redwood support: Neha) — Target: 2027-03-25
6) End-to-end QA + sign-off (owners: joint) — Target close date: 2027-03-31

Dependencies / open questions:
- Auth: Will you use customer-managed keys (KMS) or Redwood-managed API keys? (affects Private deployment timeline)
- Geocoding tool endpoint: please confirm SLA and auth method so we can design the tool-calling connector.
- Data retention / logs: confirm retention window for KV cache traces (default 7d) if needed for debugging.

Attachments: I attached a MAP draft (ACME_MAP-MAP_Draft_v2.pdf) and a spreadsheet with suggested owners/breakdown. Please review and propose edits inline.

Next step: Can Priya & Sam confirm owners and the design sign-off target (2027-02-18)? Once agreed, Rafael/Vivek will produce a short technical spec for the SDK and streaming paths.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

---
Attachment: ACME_MAP-MAP_Draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
Attachment: integration_owners.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

From: Sam Harris <sam.harris@acme-maps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Varma <priya.varma@acme-maps.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs) — Acme Maps

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Auth: we'll start with Redwood-managed API keys for POC, but we need KMS for production (so the MAP should include an optional KMS handoff).
2) Geocoding tool: we use GeoSolve API (https://api.geosolve.com) with token-based auth; SLA is 99.9% and average latency 80-120ms. I'll share the contract doc.
3) Structured outputs: our analytics team prefers a fixed JSON schema (I attached a short example in a follow-up).

Owners (proposed):
- Design sign-off: Priya (lead), Sam (tech sponsor)
- Tool-calling connector: Sam + Redwood SE (Vivek)
- SDK integration: Acme eng (lead) with Redwood devrel support (Rafael)

We can confirm design sign-off by 2027-02-18. One ask: Rafael / Vivek, can you produce the SDK spec + a short doc on streaming behavior (latency expectations, reconnect strategy) by 2027-02-22?

Thanks,
Sam
Sr. Platform Engineer | Acme Maps
sam.harris@acme-maps.com

Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs) — Acme Maps

Thanks Sam — happy to own the SDK spec. Draft plan from Redwood side: 

- Deliverable: SDK (JS + Python) with examples for streaming and non-streaming calls, and an integration sample that calls GeoSolve as a tool.
- Timeline: spec by 2027-02-22, alpha SDK by 2027-03-04, public examples by 2027-03-11.
- Streaming notes (for Vivek): continuous chunked responses with resumption token; we recommend a 45s heartbeat and an opt-in reconnect hook if session drops.
- Structured outputs: we'll include a JSON schema template and a validation library in SDK.

Vivek — adding you for infra validation on KV cache retention and streaming load tests. Neha — we'll coordinate support runbooks for QA and production rollout.

Rafael Mendes
Developer Relations | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs) — Acme Maps

Quick infra notes from my side: 
- KV cache retention: default 7d ok for troubleshooting; if Acme wants longer we can add a 30d tier but it requires an SSO role and retention cost add-on.
- Streaming load tests: we'll run a 48-hour soak starting 2027-03-06 against a staging pool. Need your expected concurrent session numbers (Sam) — please provide by 2027-02-22.
- Tool-calling: Redwood can host a proxy connector for GeoSolve to standardize auth and retries; requires a signed SLA with GeoSolve or a token escrow pattern.

Sam / Priya — confirming: we’re good on the timeline above; next milestone is design sign-off week of 2027-02-15 (we can do a 30-min sync if helpful).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
